title: Repaired trader paper book is paused on a US symbol and its ledger row floods directory warnings

problem_register_ref.section: RC4. Nobody looks at the whole design
problem_register_ref.row: Agora servant row; updated by the register owner (f4c32790) with this task, not edited here

root_cause.universe: The hosted ledger row (pre-#7983) has no request_payload.symbols, so PersonaProvisioningCoordinator._paper_universe (persona_provisioning_coordinator.py ~3963) minted and approved the book's StrategyArtifact on the legacy SPY default. PAPER-TRADER-BOOK-EXECUTABLE-INTENT-ONLY-20261127 commit 4fc8eb0e4 removed the SPY->2330.TW swap from _resolve_paper_book_execution_projection, so the in-place repair projected the approved SPY artifact: binding metadata.symbol=SPY. The reconciler (paper_fleet_reconciler.py _check_market_admission ~2142) then asked Source for SPY and paused the binding with session_admission.reason_code=market_input_missing. trader_paper_book.py::_binding_has_executable_projection did not look at the symbol, so a replay of ensure treated the SPY-projected binding as complete, and _validate_runtime_binding_readback rejected the paused binding with runtime_binding_not_active before any repair.
root_cause.ledger_warning: The book's bff.persona_provisioning row shares the servant persona_id but its normalized_name (agora-servant-<id>) differs from the servant Persona name, so _persona_record_for_provisioning raised ProvisioningConflict for it on every directory read (personas/service.py ~2871, ~2968) and logged a warning without an id (2979 times 04:01Z-10:47Z). The row stayed state=provisioning, current_step=deployment_plan_readback, attempt_count=50 because nothing ever finalized it.

design_constraint.summary: The approved artifact (registry_id, version, checksum) is immutable and RuntimeBinding.artifact_id/artifact_version/plan_id cannot be changed by transition (only metadata merges). The legacy artifact's own parameters.symbols therefore stay ['SPY'] for this binding id. The repair keeps the approved object_store, artifact_checksum and market_data_policy byte for byte and moves only the projected market symbol to the book default universe, with provenance in metadata.book_universe. A trader paper book emits no strategy signals (paper_signal_producer.py _is_trader_servant_paper_book_binding), so the artifact's own universe is never evaluated.
design_constraint.reviewer_attention: If the reviewer requires the approved artifact itself to carry 2330.TW, that needs a runtime-manager re-point of artifact_id/version on the same binding id (a new writer, out of this task's artifacts and the no-new-writer budget) or a new binding id; neither is attempted here.

changes.summary: trader_paper_book_default_universe (TWD -> 2330.TW) is now the single source for new and repaired books. _resolve_paper_book_execution_projection applies _apply_book_default_universe_to_legacy_projection only when the approved artifact's own universe is exactly the legacy default SPY with no market and the book currency has a different default universe. _binding_has_executable_projection now returns False for a TWD book projected on SPY, so ensure repairs it and a repaired book is left unchanged on replay. _repair_runtime_binding_execution_projection_in_place repairs an active binding (pending_pause, paused, active) or a binding the reconciler paused with session_admission.reason_code market_input_* (paused metadata patch, then active) on the same binding_id; an operator pause or any other pause still raises runtime_binding_not_active with zero transitions, and an already-executable market-paused book is left to the reconciler. _finalize_trader_paper_book_ledger_record moves the book's existing ledger row to state=succeeded, current_step=trader_paper_book_provisioned through the existing store acquire/release, never creates a row, never revives retired/compensated, and writes nothing on replay. is_trader_paper_book_ledger_record identifies the row by the trader-paper-book: idempotency-key prefix and the user_private_agora_servant_paper_book mandate (hosted rows have no book_kind).

The Persona directory projection, the single-persona detail read and the paper risk renewal scan skip the trader paper book ledger row (it is not a Persona provisioning request). A real Persona provisioning conflict is untouched: it is still skipped and still logs.

New: recorded hosted legacy book (SPY artifact leased by the legacy ledger row; binding paused by the reconciler, and an active variant), operator-pause and executable-market-pause preservation, directory/detail warning counts, ledger classifier.
The book row is now terminal (succeeded) after ensure; the hosted provisioning-shaped record is asserted as a detached record. Enrollment stays non-actionable for both.

AC1_legacy_spy_book_moves_to_twd_univers.facts: Hosted ids rb-77d962be4e324032808324109f2c154e / pool-persona-paper-3ca8da543bef6ede0a07 / pcb-persona-paper-3ca8da543bef6ede0a07. After ensure: one CapitalPool, one PersonaCapitalBinding, one RuntimeBinding (same id), status active, metadata.symbol=2330.TW, object_store/artifact_checksum/market_data_policy equal the approved SPY projection, desired-state lists the binding with no exclusions. See design_constraint for the artifact's own universe.

residual_findings.summary: The legacy book's approved artifact parameters.symbols remain ['SPY'] (immutable registry entry, immutable binding artifact identity). Only the projected binding symbol moves to 2330.TW. Irrelevant to execution because a trader paper book emits no strategy signals; recorded so a future re-point mechanism can close it.
